Squidpy neighborhood niches on ileum GALT

On this Xu 2026 ileum slice, does the gut-associated lymphoid tissue (GALT) follicle come out as its own Squidpy niche, or dissolve into lamina propria? Neighborhood size k in sq.gr.spatial_neighbors decides it. We cluster with groups="cell_type" (cryptopatch / ILF-like cDC, ILC3, FRC aggregates, not classical B/T zones). The tutorial selection is a compact niche_k30_res0.3 blob (follicle-like); that niche is 537 cells slice-wide (64.6% GALT in anatomical_layer); 123 of the selected cells share that niche label. At niche_k8_res0.3, the selection maps to one 2,973-cell niche with 281 GALT cells (9%), so the follicle read merges into lamina propria. Open in molab: squidpy_color.py
Static docs view: niches are precomputed and baked into the export. Switch between the two k niche columns (fixed Leiden resolution 0.3) in the widget categorical tab (no kernel). The map shows the full slice zoomed to fit; focus the GALT selection in the layers list for a follicle crop. The composition figure matches niche_k30_res0.3 and that selection.
